title: 第11章 坊市之谈
content_zh:
张山、孙康、刘兰三人面带笑容离去之后，李老道面上笑容缓缓褪去，叹息一声坐在桌子前面，连饭菜也没心情去吃。

    “小娃儿，你说，人的命是不是天注定？”

    “刘兰这小女娃的三灵根就这般好，修炼又快，以后筑基都说不定有望，连王管事都不克扣她灵米收获。”

    “我这一把年纪，又是五灵根……方执事当初说的，还真是一点没错，若是按部就班，恐怕一生也难入外门！”

    一开始，李老道还只是抱怨，说到最后，却是一拍桌子霍然站起，声音嘶哑，丑脸狰狞双眼血丝密布，显然已经情绪激动至极。

    韩榆劝道：“道爷，咱们虽然是杂役弟子，但好歹有机会修行，总比那些终生无望、没有灵根的仆从们好的多。”

    万春谷的规矩向来是如此，除非双灵根以上的天才可能直接被长老收徒提前进内门、外门，三灵根、四灵根、五灵根这三种资质不太好的灵根都要从杂役弟子做起。

    三灵根资质的弟子因为在杂役弟子中属于资质好，修炼快的，向来不受欺压，基本最终都会成为外门弟子。

    四灵根、五灵根就不好说了……

    “说得轻巧！”

    李老道握紧拳头，向外走去：“老道我也曾纵马快意，逍遥武林，一生求仙问道，难道是为了这般无能为力？”

    说完之后，也不再和韩榆多说，大踏步地离去。

    背影毅然决然。

    韩榆怔怔看了两眼，低头继续吃饭。

    道爷做的兔子肉，真好吃啊，也不知以后还能不能吃到这种事先放过血的兔子……

    第二日，韩榆与李老道两人来到刘兰的石屋之外。

    除了张山、孙康之外，另有两个男弟子、一个颇为漂亮的女弟子也前来为刘兰庆祝。

    “刘师妹不愧是三灵根的资质，于咱们杂役弟子中绝对是天才！”

    “是啊，过不了多久，就该称呼刘师姐了！”
content_en:
Page (1/3)

There are four strange stars in the Southern Territory and one strange star in the Central Heaven Territory.

Apart from this, there are no strange stars in the stars.

Han Yu stood outside the main hall, looking away, thinking about the possible situation he might face.

Qutanhua was originally on the stars, but after it was moved this time, it did not appear on the stars. The landing point of the moved stone slab was indeed unusual and controllable.

This should not be hidden intentionally, but it is outside the stars.

Will other god-transformation monks come to the Southern Region?

Ten god-transformation monks join forces, Xuan Luzi is crippled, White Bone Ancestor is dead, Qu Tanhua escapes... What will the remaining seven choose?

Han Yu was not sure, and expected the enemy to be strict. The situation was not optimistic, but it was far from as desperate as before.

Also, why can't Ye Guxing and Xuanyangzi be contacted?

With a thought, Han Yu condensed a blood avatar, put in a blood essence bead and a touch of spiritual consciousness, and released the blood avatar out of Wanchun Valley, heading straight to Jinxia Temple in Nanhai Kingdom.

As for Ye Guxing and Meng Qingtong in the Zhongtian Territory further away, Han Yu could not contact them, and it was difficult for blood avatars or puppets to reach them, so they could only wait for the time being.

After the blood incarnation left, the night gradually passed, and the sky turned white.

After removing the hidden danger, Zhong Yue, Sun Kang and Liu Lan walked out of the hall and saluted in front of Han Yu: "Young Master."

Han Yu nodded slightly, took out three bottles of Qi-training and Spirit-enhancing Pills and handed them to the three of them: "No need to be polite. It turns out that you have been implicated by me in this matter. Practice well after you go back."

Zhong Yue, Sun Kang and Liu Lan all declined immediately.

"Young Master, it's the enemy's fault for attacking, how can I blame you?"

Han Yu looked at them with a smile: "Okay, let's not distinguish between right and wrong, just treat it as my thoughts."

"When you are surrounded by strong enemies, you still think of me, and I am grateful in my heart."

They persuaded the three of them to accept the Qi-training and Spirit-increasing Pills. Later, they saw that Li Yunxia, Yuan Shengjiao, Ye Shinian and others had also been eliminated from hidden dangers and walked out of the hall one after another.

Han Yu talked to them for a few words and asked them what spiritual plants they had chosen as auxiliary spiritual plants for practice. Since the Eternal Spring Method was revised in Wanchun Valley, the elders and potential foundation-building realm disciples have begun to choose auxiliary spiritual plants. Firstly, they can increase their cultivation faster, and secondly, this refining spiritual plant may also become an important helper in fighting.

The monks who practice the Eternal Spring Method and the spiritual plants also have the wonderful effect of mutual assistance and spiritual interaction.

Therefore, Li Yunxia, ​​Yuan Shengjiao and others have already refined spiritual plants.
